changes.name: RemoveSmallLeftChunkV41
changes.source:
local world=workspace:WaitForChild("GrowIslandWorld")

-- Remove ONLY the small legacy chunk directly to the left of the starter island.
-- Do not remove normal north/east/south expansion land.
local function removeLittleLeftChunk()
 for _,obj in ipairs(world:GetDescendants()) do
  if obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj.Name~="StarterIsland" and obj.Name~="IslandEarth" then
   local x,z=obj.Position.X,obj.Position.Z
   local sx,sz=obj.Size.X,obj.Size.Z

   -- The unwanted piece shown beside the upgrade signs sits immediately west
   -- of the starter island, centered near Z=0. Keep this intentionally narrow.
   if x < -27 and x > -55 and math.abs(z) < 22 and sx <= 40 and sz <= 50 then
    if obj.Name:find("Expansion") or obj.Name:match("^L%d+_") then
     obj:Destroy()
    end
   end
  end
 end
end

removeLittleLeftChunk()
task.delay(1,removeLittleLeftChunk)
print("Removed only the small left-side island chunk")
